create.name: Joseph Le Page
create.bio:
Joseph Le Page is a yoga teacher and trainer who started Integrative Yoga Therapy in 1993, one of the early training programmes for yoga teachers wanting to work in a therapeutic way. With his wife and fellow teacher Lilian Aboim, who has taught yoga since the mid-1980s and studied the Bhagavad Gita in the Arsha Vidya tradition, he set up Enchanted Mountain (Montanha Encantada), a large yoga retreat centre on a hundred acres of rainforest at Garopaba in southern Brazil, where Integrative Yoga is now based. His earlier background includes Kripalu Yoga and Tibetan Buddhism.

The Integrative Yoga approach is built on the five koshas, the yogic map of the layers of a person from the body through breath, mind and wisdom to spirit, and it draws on postures, pranayama, mudra, guided imagery, yoga nidra and meditation. Joseph and Lilian co-wrote the Yoga Toolbox for Teachers and Students, now an online app with a large video library, and Mudras for Healing and Transformation. Joseph records many guided meditations at beginner, intermediate and advanced levels, teaches courses on the Yoga Sutras and on mudras, and hosts a week-long Ayurveda and yoga retreat in Brazil for English speakers.

courses.title: Ayurveda and Yoga Healing Retreat, Enchanted Mountain, Brazil
courses.description: A week at Enchanted Mountain in Garopaba, southern Brazil, hosted by Joseph with the centre's English-speaking team: daily yoga, pranayama, meditation, yoga nidra and restorative practice, Ayurvedic massage and shirodhara, vegetarian meals and coastal walks. Accommodation for seven nights is included.
courses.price: USD$1895 (double occupancy) / USD$2295 (single occupancy) until 30 November 2026; USD$2095 / USD$2495 from 1 December 2026

courses.title: Yoga Toolbox for Teachers and Students: Online Version and E-book
courses.description: The fourth edition of the Yoga Toolbox that Joseph and Lilian wrote, as a web app with more than a thousand short videos and an e-book. It sets out each posture across body, subtle body, mind and spirit, for personal practice or for teachers planning classes.

free_resources.title: Free Online Course: Introduction to Mudras, with Joseph Le Page
free_resources.description: A free recorded course of about fifty minutes in which Joseph introduces the yogic hand gestures known as mudras and how they are used in meditation and practice.
